dict.string: SauceCtrl looks for Git repositories in your Documents folder and opens the ones you choose.
SauceCtrl looks for Git repositories on your Desktop and opens the ones you choose.
SauceCtrl looks for Git repositories in your Downloads folder and opens the ones you choose.
SauceCtrl looks for Git repositories on external drives and opens the ones you choose.
SauceCtrl looks for Git repositories on network drives and opens the ones you choose.
